CREATE TABLE `audit_operations` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `usuario_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `accion` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `entidad` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `entidad_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `valores_antes` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `valores_despues` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `motivo` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_audit_operations_user` (`usuario_id`),
  KEY `ix_ao_entidad_created` (`entidad`,`entidad_id`,`created_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_audit_operations_user` FOREIGN KEY (`usuario_id`) REFERENCES `auth_users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `audit_pii_access` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `usuario_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `accion` enum('consulta','creacion','modificacion','exportacion') NOT NULL,
  `paciente_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `prescription_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `motivo` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_audit_pii_user` (`usuario_id`),
  KEY `ix_apii_paciente_created` (`paciente_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `ix_apii_prescription_created` (`prescription_id`,`created_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_audit_pii_paciente` FOREIGN KEY (`paciente_id`) REFERENCES `catalog_patients` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_audit_pii_prescription` FOREIGN KEY (`prescription_id`) REFERENCES `rx_prescriptions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_audit_pii_user` FOREIGN KEY (`usuario_id`) REFERENCES `auth_users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_apii_objetivo` CHECK (((`paciente_id` is not null) or (`prescription_id` is not null)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `auth_permissions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `clave` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `descripcion` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_auth_permissions_clave` (`clave`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `auth_role_permissions` (
  `role_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `permission_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`role_id`,`permission_id`),
  KEY `fk_arp_permission` (`permission_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_arp_permission` FOREIGN KEY (`permission_id`) REFERENCES `auth_permissions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_arp_role` FOREIGN KEY (`role_id`) REFERENCES `auth_roles` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE

CREATE TABLE `auth_roles` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nombre` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `descripcion` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_auth_roles_nombre` (`nombre`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=6 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `auth_user_roles` (
  `user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `role_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`,`role_id`),
  KEY `fk_aur_role` (`role_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_aur_role` FOREIGN KEY (`role_id`) REFERENCES `auth_roles` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_aur_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `auth_users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `auth_users` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `usuario` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `password_hash` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `estado` enum('activo','bloqueado','inactivo') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'activo',
  `mfa_habilitado` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `ultimo_acceso_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_auth_users_usuario` (`usuario`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `catalog_categories` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `nombre` varchar(150) NOT NULL,
  `parent_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `parent_id_key` bigint unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS (ifnull(`parent_id`,0)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_catalog_categories_nombre_parent` (`nombre`,`parent_id_key`),
  KEY `fk_catalog_categories_parent` (`parent_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_catalog_categories_parent` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_id`) REFERENCES `catalog_categories` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `catalog_patients` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `identificacion` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `nombre` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `fecha_nacimiento` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `contacto` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `estado` enum('activo','anonimizado') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'activo',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `anonimizado_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_catalog_patients_identificacion` (`identificacion`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `catalog_prescribers` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `identificacion` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `nombre` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `especialidad` varchar(150) DEFAULT NULL,
  `estado` enum('activo','inactivo','anonimizado') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'activo',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_catalog_prescribers_identificacion` (`identificacion`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `catalog_prices` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `product_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `store_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `store_id_key` bigint unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS (ifnull(`store_id`,0)) STORED,
  `precio` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `vigente_desde` date NOT NULL,
  `vigente_hasta` date DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_catalog_prices` (`product_id`,`store_id_key`,`vigente_desde`),
  KEY `fk_catalog_prices_store` (`store_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_catalog_prices_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `catalog_products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_catalog_prices_store` FOREIGN KEY (`store_id`) REFERENCES `ops_stores` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_catalog_prices_precio` CHECK ((`precio` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `catalog_product_categories` (
  `product_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `category_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`,`category_id`),
  KEY `fk_cpc_category` (`category_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cpc_category` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `catalog_categories` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cpc_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `catalog_products` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `catalog_products` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `sku` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `nombre` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `principio_activo` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `presentacion` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `concentracion` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `condicion_venta` enum('libre','receta','controlado') NOT NULL,
  `estado` enum('activo','inactivo') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'activo',
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_catalog_products_sku` (`sku`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `catalog_promotions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `product_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `category_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `descuento_pct` decimal(5,2) NOT NULL,
  `desde` date NOT NULL,
  `hasta` date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_catalog_promotions_product` (`product_id`),
  KEY `fk_catalog_promotions_category` (`category_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_catalog_promotions_category` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `catalog_categories` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_catalog_promotions_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `catalog_products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_catalog_promotions_alcance` CHECK (((`product_id` is not null) or (`category_id` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_catalog_promotions_pct` CHECK (((`descuento_pct` > 0) and (`descuento_pct` <= 100))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_catalog_promotions_rango` CHECK ((`hasta` >= `desde`))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `catalog_suppliers` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `identificacion` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `nombre` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  `contacto` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `estado` enum('activo','inactivo') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'activo',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_catalog_suppliers_identificacion` (`identificacion`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `ctrl_balances` (
  `store_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `product_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `saldo` int NOT NULL,
  `version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`store_id`,`product_id`),
  KEY `fk_ctrl_balances_product` (`product_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ctrl_balances_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `catalog_products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ctrl_balances_store` FOREIGN KEY (`store_id`) REFERENCES `ops_stores` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_ctrl_balances_saldo` CHECK ((`saldo` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `ctrl_ledger_entries` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `store_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `product_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `tipo` enum('entrada','salida','ajuste','devolucion','transferencia_out','transferencia_in') NOT NULL,
  `cantidad` int NOT NULL,
  `saldo_resultante` int NOT NULL,
  `usuario_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `autorizador_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `motivo` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `ref_tipo` enum('venta','recepcion','transferencia','devolucion','ajuste') NOT NULL,
  `ref_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_cle_product` (`product_id`),
  KEY `fk_cle_usuario` (`usuario_id`),
  KEY `fk_cle_autorizador` (`autorizador_id`),
  KEY `ix_cle_store_product_created` (`store_id`,`product_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `ix_cle_ref` (`ref_tipo`,`ref_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cle_autorizador` FOREIGN KEY (`autorizador_id`) REFERENCES `auth_users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cle_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `catalog_products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cle_store` FOREIGN KEY (`store_id`) REFERENCES `ops_stores` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cle_usuario` FOREIGN KEY (`usuario_id`) REFERENCES `auth_users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cle_ajuste_autorizado` CHECK (((`tipo` <> _utf8mb4'ajuste') or (`autorizador_id` is not null))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cle_cantidad` CHECK ((`cantidad` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cle_doble_autorizacion` CHECK (((`autorizador_id` is null) or (`autorizador_id` <> `usuario_id`))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_cle_saldo` CHECK ((`saldo_resultante` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `idempotency_keys` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `idempotency_key` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `operacion` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `request_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `respuesta_ref` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `estado` enum('en_proceso','completado') NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_idempotency_keys_key` (`idempotency_key`),
  KEY `ix_ik_expires` (`expires_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `inventory_alerts` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `tipo` enum('stock_minimo','vencimiento') NOT NULL,
  `product_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `store_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `store_id_key` bigint unsigned GENERATED ALWAYS AS (ifnull(`store_id`,0)) STORED,
  `fecha_generada` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `estado` enum('abierta','resuelta') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'abierta',
  `resuelta_por` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `resuelta_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_inventory_alerts` (`tipo`,`product_id`,`store_id_key`,`fecha_generada`),
  KEY `fk_inventory_alerts_product` (`product_id`),
  KEY `fk_inventory_alerts_store` (`store_id`),
  KEY `fk_inventory_alerts_resuelta` (`resuelta_por`),
  KEY `ix_ia_tipo_estado_fecha` (`tipo`,`estado`,`fecha_generada`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_inventory_alerts_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `catalog_products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_inventory_alerts_resuelta` FOREIGN KEY (`resuelta_por`) REFERENCES `auth_users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_inventory_alerts_store` FOREIGN KEY (`store_id`) REFERENCES `ops_stores` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `inventory_incidents` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `store_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `lot_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `stock_registrado` int NOT NULL,
  `consumo_declarado` int NOT NULL,
  `estado` enum('abierto','ajustado','descartado') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'abierto',
  `abierto_por` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `movimiento_ajuste_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_inventory_incidents_lot` (`lot_id`),
  KEY `fk_inventory_incidents_user` (`abierto_por`),
  KEY `fk_inventory_incidents_mov` (`movimiento_ajuste_id`),
  KEY `ix_ii_store_estado` (`store_id`,`estado`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_inventory_incidents_lot` FOREIGN KEY (`lot_id`) REFERENCES `inventory_lots` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_inventory_incidents_mov` FOREIGN KEY (`movimiento_ajuste_id`) REFERENCES `inventory_movements` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_inventory_incidents_store` FOREIGN KEY (`store_id`) REFERENCES `ops_stores` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_inventory_incidents_user` FOREIGN KEY (`abierto_por`) REFERENCES `auth_users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `inventory_lots` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `product_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `numero_lote` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `fecha_vencimiento` date NOT NULL,
  `estado` enum('cuarentena','liberado','retirado') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cuarentena',
  `reception_item_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `liberado_por` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `liberado_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `motivo_liberacion` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  `retirado_at` datetime(6) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_inventory_lots_producto_lote` (`product_id`,`numero_lote`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_inventory_lots_reception` (`reception_item_id`),
  KEY `fk_inventory_lots_liberado_por` (`liberado_por`),
  KEY `ix_inventory_lots_fefo` (`product_id`,`estado`,`fecha_vencimiento`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_inventory_lots_liberado_por` FOREIGN KEY (`liberado_por`) REFERENCES `auth_users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_inventory_lots_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `catalog_products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_inventory_lots_reception` FOREIGN KEY (`reception_item_id`) REFERENCES `purchase_reception_items` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_inventory_lots_liberacion` CHECK (((`estado` <> _utf8mb4'liberado') or ((`liberado_por` is not null) and (`liberado_at` is not null) and (`motivo_liberacion` is not null))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `inventory_movements` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `store_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `lot_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `product_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `tipo` enum('entrada','salida','ajuste_baja','ajuste_incremento','devolucion','transferencia_salida','transferencia_entrada','compensatorio') NOT NULL,
  `cantidad` int NOT NULL,
  `signo` smallint NOT NULL,
  `usuario_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `motivo` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `proponente_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `autorizador_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `ref_tipo` enum('venta','recepcion','transferencia','devolucion','incidente','manual') DEFAULT NULL,
  `ref_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `movimiento_ref_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `idempotency_key` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_im_idem` (`idempotency_key`),
  KEY `fk_im_product` (`product_id`),
  KEY `fk_im_usuario` (`usuario_id`),
  KEY `fk_im_proponente` (`proponente_id`),
  KEY `fk_im_autorizador` (`autorizador_id`),
  KEY `fk_im_ref` (`movimiento_ref_id`),
  KEY `ix_im_lot_created` (`lot_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `ix_im_store_created` (`store_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `ix_im_ref` (`ref_tipo`,`ref_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_im_autorizador` FOREIGN KEY (`autorizador_id`) REFERENCES `auth_users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_im_lot` FOREIGN KEY (`lot_id`) REFERENCES `inventory_lots` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_im_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `catalog_products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_im_proponente` FOREIGN KEY (`proponente_id`) REFERENCES `auth_users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_im_ref` FOREIGN KEY (`movimiento_ref_id`) REFERENCES `inventory_movements` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_im_store` FOREIGN KEY (`store_id`) REFERENCES `ops_stores` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_im_usuario` FOREIGN KEY (`usuario_id`) REFERENCES `auth_users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_im_cantidad` CHECK ((`cantidad` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_im_doble_autorizacion` CHECK (((`autorizador_id` is null) or (`proponente_id` is null) or (`autorizador_id` <> `proponente_id`))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_im_ref` CHECK (((`ref_tipo` is not null) or (`tipo` in (_utf8mb4'ajuste_incremento',_utf8mb4'ajuste_baja')))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_im_signo` CHECK ((`signo` in (-(1),1)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `inventory_reservations` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `order_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `product_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `store_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `qty` int NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','confirmed','expired','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `expires_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `fk_ir_order` (`order_id`),
  KEY `fk_ir_product` (`product_id`),
  KEY `ix_ir_store_product_status_expires` (`store_id`,`product_id`,`status`,`expires_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ir_order` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `sales_orders` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ir_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `catalog_products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ir_store` FOREIGN KEY (`store_id`) REFERENCES `ops_stores` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_ir_qty` CHECK ((`qty` > 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `inventory_stock` (
  `store_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `lot_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `stock_available` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `stock_reserved` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `stock_sold` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `updated_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),
  PRIMARY KEY (`store_id`,`lot_id`),
  KEY `ix_inventory_stock_lot_store` (`lot_id`,`store_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_inventory_stock_lot` FOREIGN KEY (`lot_id`) REFERENCES `inventory_lots` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_inventory_stock_store` FOREIGN KEY (`store_id`) REFERENCES `ops_stores` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
